_authoring_mode_comment: Hand-authored spec-as-fixture for v1.1.5 (B3). The orchestrator does NOT yet honor --strict-on-hard-a51; this fixture documents the proposed contract for the v1.2-candidate implementation. The integration test asserts (a) the canonical state is schema-conforming today, AND (b) the proposed strict-mode pre-flight pseudo-code (mocked) produces the expected BLOCKED message shape.
_model_fields_comment: model_used / model_version_hash will remain n/a — this fixture's whole point is to be a deterministic regression baseline for an opt-in failure-mode contract.
covers: spec for the proposed --strict-on-hard-a51 opt-in failure mode
canonical state with exactly one hard-blocking unresolved contradiction A51 row
expected BLOCKED message shape (stderr keywords + exit code)
does_not_cover: Live orchestrator behavior — the strict-mode flag does not exist today (v1.2 candidate)
Soft / informational A51 rows — those NEVER block, even in strict mode (out of scope for this fixture)
Multi-blocker BLOCKED-message format — pinned in README but not exhaustively covered
future_implementation_notes: When --strict-on-hard-a51 lands (v1.2), expand the test from mocked-pre-flight to direct /bsa-promote invocation. The hook script would set BSA_STRICT_ON_HARD_A51=1 from the CLI flag, and the orchestrator's promote step would read it before acquiring the canonical write lock.
